jobs.title: About us
jobs.description: ABOUT US Plarium TAKE THE WORLD Plarium Global Ltd. is dedicated to creating the best mobile and PC experience for our community of over 500 million mid-core and casual registered gamers worldwide. Our diverse portfolio includes 20 games ranging from hardcore RPGs to casual adventures, featuring acclaimed titles such as RAID: Shadow Legends, Mech Arena, Vikings: War of Clans, Lost Island: Blast Adventure, and the Stormfall franchise. The App Store and Google Play regularly feature our games, with Facebook twice recognizing us as a top hardcore Facebook developer. We employ more than 1300 specialists and are headquartered in Israel with seven offices and development studios across Europe. Our games are available on iOS, Android, and PC. They are also available through Plarium Play, our optimized game launcher for PC and Mac players. OUR ETHOS OUR VISION To create the world’s largest gaming community, etching the Plarium name into gaming history. OUR MISSION To create the most immersive, awe-inspiring games that enrich the lives of millions worldwide. Where we create Seven studios with one vision. We are driven by over 1300 passionate employees that work in Israel, Poland, Finland, Spain, and Ukraine. jobs.title: Junior Data QA Engineer General Office: Kharkiv, Lviv Remote: Ukraine
jobs.description: VACANCIES Junior Data QA Engineer General Office: Kharkiv, Lviv Remote: Ukraine The successful applicant will be able to work at our Lviv office or Kharkiv office or remotely in Ukraine. Plarium is an international developer of award-winning mobile and desktop games. More than 1200 of our specialists work remotely or at offices in Israel, Ukraine, Poland and Spain. RAID: Shadow Legends, Mech Arena, and our other 18 massive titles unite more than 500 million players worldwide. With over 17 years’ experience, we strive for boundary-pushing gameplay and graphics. We pair this with our dedication to innovation through analytics, marketing, and community interaction. The Game BI team develops its own tools for processing and storing analytical data. The system processes over two billion events daily. The data obtained is used by the analytics team to adjust the game balance in every Plarium game. Together with the team, you will work on a wide range of tasks to ensure data quality across all stages of the product lifecycle. You will analyze requirements, design data logging, test logs and tables, assist in investigating player inquiries, maintain QA documentation, and automate various processes. Responsibilities Improving your knowledge of SQL Discovering how to locate data bugs Creating data quality requirements and testing their implementation Collaborating with Marketing, Community, Development, and Analytics teams What we expect Basic experience writing SQL queries Strong analytical mindset High attention to detail Experience using AI tools Keen interest in gaming Hands-on experience with Google Sheets Desired Experience with mobile games Knowledge of any programming language (we use C# and Python) What we offer Officially registered full-time employment Minimum of 25 calendar days of paid vacation annually, separately paid public holidays, and additional paid leave for specific needs Medical support and fully paid leave if you or your child are sick Reimbursement for the cost of a coworking space Individual development plan and regular feedback Professional seminars, workshops, courses, and internal training programs Educational English courses Opportunity to take an interest-free loan Counseling with psychologists and mental health workshops Reimbursement of gym membership fees, and running club Send CV Ready to apply? jobs.description: VACANCIES Real-Time VFX Artist RAID: Shadow Legends Office: Barcelona, Kharkiv, Lviv, Warsaw Remote: Poland, Spain, Ukraine The successful applicant will be able to work at our offices in Lviv, Kharkiv, Warsaw, Barcelona, or remotely from Ukraine, Poland or Spain. Plarium is an international developer of award-winning mobile and desktop games. More than 1200 of our specialists work remotely or at offices in Israel, Ukraine, Poland, and Spain. RAID, Mech Arena, and our other 18 massive titles unite more than 500 million players worldwide. With over 17 years’ experience, we strive for boundary-pushing gameplay and graphics. We pair this with our dedication to innovation through analytics, marketing, and community interaction. We are looking for a talented Real-Time VFX Artist to join our RPG Department, which develops RAID – a mobile MMORPG that combines battle collection mechanics and cutting-edge graphics in a dark fantasy setting. As our flagship title, it is enjoyed by more than 100 million players worldwide. You can find it on iOS, Android, and PC/Mac. RAID is made in Unity, but the team also uses a variety of other tools for specific tasks: Maya for 3D modeling and UV, ZBrush and Blender for sculpting, Houdini for pyro, fluid, and destruction simulations, Substance Designer for texture generation, Substance Painter for baking and texturing, Xcode for profiling, and Amplify Shader Editor for prototyping shaders. The successful candidate will work closely with 11 Technical and Real-time VFX artists. A showcase of our art team’s work can be found on ArtStation. Responsibilities Creating concept designs and developing real-time VFX for mobile games in Unity Profiling and optimizing effects and game assets created by you or by others Customizing the VFX of game characters’ skills using internal tools Creating 3D models and animations for VFX when needed What we expect At least 1 year of work experience in the games industry Knowledge of the principles of motion, anticipation, dynamics, and other aspects of animation Firm knowledge of Unity editor Experience creating VFX for games Experience creating or writing VFX shaders in node-based editors Knowledge of Houdini, Blender, Maya, or 3ds Max 3D modeling and 3D animation skills Experience creating UV maps and baking them Experience creating textures for VFX In-depth experience with Particle Systems in Unity English language skills at the intermediate level or higher Desired Understanding of mobile device hardware restrictions Experience working with Houdini and Houdini Engine for Unity Hands-on experience with Substance Painter and Designer Experience working with GIT or similar version control systems What we offer Officially registered full-time employment Paid leave of 20 or 26 days depending upon work experience Medical insurance and paid leave if you or your child are sick Opportunity for counseling with psychologists Individual development plan and regular feedback Professional seminars, workshops, courses, and internal training programs Sports membership at 4500+ facilities across Poland with the MultiSport Plus Card A running club Send CV Ready to apply?
